facts.fact: The latest published NCRB 'Crime in India' report is for the year 2024
facts.quote: The National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) compiles and publishes the statistical data on crimes in its publication “Crime in India”. The latest published report is for the year 2024.

facts.fact: 1,01,928 cyber crime cases were registered in India in 2024 (Crime in India 2024, Table 9A.1), up from 86,420 in 2023

behaviour: Gives the all-India cyber crime figure with the NCRB report year (Crime in India 2024), citing NCRB (or the MHA/PIB reply reproducing it); neutral wording, no commentary.
fail_if: It gives an older report's figure (e.g. 86,420 for 2023 or 65,893 for 2022) as the latest; gives a figure without the report year; cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added: latest NCRB report is Crime in India 2024; 1,01,928 cyber crime cases registered in 2024 (86,420 in 2023).
